code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
# Provenance table: TmCdsA -> E. coli CdsA active-site mapping with all computed quantities
rows = [
 # tm_pdb, tm_unp, role, ec, contact_dist_A, ec_z, d_Mg, d_K, pLDDT, pct_orth
 (239,'D219','Mg2+ ligand (OD1, bidentate) + K+ ligand (O/OD2)','D235',2.13,-13.6,4.0,3.3,97,100),
 (269,'D249','Mg2+ ligand (OD1) + K+ ligand (OD2)','D265',2.12,-11.0,5.2,6.9,96,100),
 (164,'D144','Mg2+ second shell (3.6 A)','D165',3.57,-9.1,6.8,11.6,96,100),
 (266,'D246','Mg2+ second shell (4.1 A)','D262',4.12,-14.9,7.1,7.1,93,100),
 (242,'E222','K+ site (3.0 A to CB/CG, OE1 4.1 A)','E238',3.04,-16.4,8.4,4.3,97,78),
 (243,'S223','K+ site (S223C in 4Q2E; 3.5 A)','S239',3.48,-19.2,9.0,3.2,97,100),
 (246,'K226','K+ site (NZ 3.7-4.7 A)','K242',3.72,-22.5,13.0,7.6,96,100),
 (187,'K167','near Mg2+ (NZ 4.9-5.3 A)','K188',4.91,-18.0,10.8,9.8,94,100),
 (270,'G250','Mg2+ via backbone N (3.5 A)','S266',3.46,-8.7,4.0,8.1,98,72),
 (235,'D215','Mg2+ second shell (3.9 A) - NOT conserved','S231',3.92,-7.3,6.3,9.9,98,25),
]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['TmCdsA_4Q2E','TmCdsA_UniProt','role_in_TmCdsA','E_coli_CdsA',
    'metal_contact_A','ec_z_A','d_to_Mg_A','d_to_K_A','pLDDT','pct_36_orthologs'])
pd.set_option('display.width',220); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',50)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/agent_out_site_mapping.csv',index=False) if False else None

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax.barh(y, df.pct_36_orthologs, color=['crimson' if p==100 else ('darkorange' if p>=70 else '0.65') for p in df.pct_36_orthologs])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{t} -> {e}" for t,e in zip(df.TmCdsA_UniProt, df.E_coli_CdsA)])
for yi,(p,z,role) in zip(y, zip(df.pct_36_orthologs, df.ec_z_A, df.role_in_TmCdsA)):
    ax.text(p+1.5, yi, f"{p:.0f}%   z={z:+.1f} Å", va='center', fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(34.7, color='royalblue', ls='--', lw=1.2)
ax.text(35.6, len(df)-0.4, 'background identity 34.7%', color='royalblue', fontsize=9, va='top')
ax.set_xlim(0,128); ax.set_xlabel('% of 36 bacterial CdsA orthologs carrying the E. coli residue')
ax.set_ylabel('TmCdsA residue -> E. coli CdsA residue')
ax.set_title('Transfer of the TmCdsA Mg$^{2+}$/K$^{+}$ site to E. coli CdsA:\nconservation and membrane depth (z<0 = cytoplasmic side; bilayer edge at -14.9 Å)', fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
